title: Texture coordinates for graphics.Quad and graphics.Cylinder, and by projection for any TriangleList
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-18: a straightforward way to put a texture on a quad and on a cylinder (an argument texture=name), and for general geometry a function that computes the texture coordinates by a planar, cylindrical or spherical projection, without the user giving them.
releaseNotes: graphics.Quad and graphics.Cylinder take texture and textureTiles; graphics.ProjectTexture gives a TriangleList texture coordinates by a planar, box, cylindrical or spherical projection; Transform, Move, InvertTriangles and MergeTriangleLists keep the texture, and a list merged with one without has the texture coordinates nan there, whose triangles are drawn without texture (revision2026c step RG6.11.6)
